provenance.note: X-ray structure of an engineered SpCas9 ternary complex at 3.59 Angstrom: one Cas9 chain (A, author residues 2-1351), one 97-nucleotide single-guide RNA (B), and separate target (C, 41 nt) and non-target (D, 25 nt) DNA strands. The deposited coordinates carry D10A and H840A, so both nuclease sites are alanine and this complex cannot cut. There are no metals, ligands or waters in the entry. SpCas9 residues 1242-1263 are replaced by a Gly-Ser linker, so author residue numbers after 1241 run 15 below the canonical SpCas9 numbering; the PAM-reading arginines usually written R1333 and R1335 are author residues 1318 and 1320 here. Every chain, residue range and distance below was measured in this entry rather than assumed. Domain boundaries are canonical SpCas9 (Nishimasu et al. 2014) and all of them fall below author residue 1241, where author and canonical numbering still agree. Measured here: guide nucleotides 3-20 pair target nucleotides 24-41, so 18 of the 20 spacer pairs are resolved; the PAM is T-G-G at D:5-7; Arg1318 and Arg1320 read dG D:6 and dG D:7 through O6 and N7 at 3.01 and 2.80 Angstrom. Both nuclease sites are not merely mutated but undocked: residue 840 lies 32-33 Angstrom from the target-strand phosphate it would cut (C:26/C:27), the inactive checkpoint conformation, and only two nucleotides of the non-target strand protospacer are modelled, so the RuvC cut site is absent from the entry entirely.

chapters.caption: Entry 9KJ6, X-ray at 3.59 Angstrom. Four chains, and one colour for each of them for the rest of this lesson: Cas9 grey, guide RNA orange, target DNA magenta, non-target DNA blue.

chapters.caption: The magenta target strand and, in yellow, the PAM, labelled on the molecule as T 5, G 6 and G 7. chapters.title: NUCLEASES
chapters.caption: Both nucleases in green, with their two active sites in red. HNH is one compact domain, canonical residues 775 to 908, and it cuts the target strand. RuvC is one active site built from three separate stretches of the same chain. Neither works here: the key catalytic residues Asp10 and His840 are replaced by alanine. HNH sits 32 Angstrom from the target-strand phosphate it would cut, and the piece of non-target strand RuvC would cut is not in the model.

immersive.narration: Nucleases are inactive. Red marks mutated active-site regions.
